chapter: New Orleans bands, Louis and the Lyric
title: Zutty was not a gambler; sports; tape pause
summary: Marge says Zutty did not gamble but liked theater and ball games. Dance notes the session was delayed for the World Series and plans a new tape.

story.theme_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: Because Zutty was never A gambler.
Oh you didn't have that problem?
No. No, he didn't gamble. I was the gambler, but he......

But he liked the better things, in life. He liked the theater very, very much. And sports. He liked ball games. I never went to a baseball game in my life. I hated baseball. But after Zutty was so interested in it, I said, well, I may as well try to find out something or to go with him.

Remember that we, don't forget Marge that we were going to finish this off, but we had to put it off for the World Series you know. You've got to put first things first. (LAUGHTER). Well now look, we are going to have to put another tape on, but we've got this connected up with ....... You had Louis at the Orchard Cabaret and now when do you play at the Cadillac?
